findings.claim: Nucor 10-K 自述鋼材在許多應用上與混凝土、鋁、塑膠、複合材料、木材競爭，替代材料用量增加可能對鋼價與需求造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In many applications, steel competes with other materials, such as concrete, aluminum, plastics, composites and wood. Increased use or availability of these materials in substitution for steel products could have a material adverse effect on prices and demand for our steel products.

findings.claim: Nucor 以電弧爐（EAF）為主、以廢鋼及替代原料（含自有 DRI）煉鋼；2025 年兩座 DRI 廠供應約 330 萬公噸。
findings.excerpt: Nucor manufactures steel principally from scrap steel and scrap steel substitutes using electric arc furnaces (“EAFs”) along with continuous casting and automated rolling mills.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：美國氫基綠鋼進展停滯，業界會議指美國買家不願付綠鋼溢價，低價高碳進口鋼被視為更大威脅；ICCT 2026-08 工作論文估 H2-DRI-EAF 綠鋼約 $812/噸，綠地廠比改造高爐-轉爐成本高約 34%。
findings.source: ICCT working paper Aug 2026; Fastmarkets; Canary Media（搜尋摘要）

note: 未找到具體取代 Nucor 核心產品的新興技術；木材/CLT 取代混凝土鋼筋之說僅為評論性文章，無量化侵蝕證據。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
